summary: Targeted actions no longer pre-select a target: the client clears Core's pre-filled first target and starts on 'Choose a target…', Confirm waits for a pick (movement too). Core publishes HarshChoicesView so the client shows the engine's consequence instead of recounting provinces. Deleted the unused client UnitForce.
validation: Core.Tests built (0 errors); EventDecisionTests HarshQueries and LastProvince pass with the new view assertions; client built (0 errors); native check-gold-payment.sh passed all 11 modes (incl. published-board-target-confirm); movement capture passed before Core's pre-filled target was cleared; support-cards default capture passed; multi-targets capture passed. NOT verified: movement capture after the final change (re-run was killed by a memory-pressure reap and its capture edit is untested); full tools/check.sh. Pre-existing on baseline (same errors with the old client): event-decisions harsh-keep 'did not commit exactly once' and attack-targets normal 'Province Attack failed or opened a card-target reaction'. Several check scripts need ripgrep (rg), absent here; verdicts were read from capture logs or via a local grep shim.
remaining: Re-run check-movement-ui.sh and confirm the updated movement capture; visual review of the Harsh Choices panel and 'Choose a target…' picker; the two baseline-failing captures need their own investigation. No Core 'optional target' flag was added: apart from the Attack family and Slots (Min 0), only Unimpeachable Name has an optional single target and it already offers a separate no-target button. Add a Core flag and a 'No target' row if more abilities are to be marked 'may'.
